items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: And then another boy, Ray, he played very well and he never did get any recognition either.

ctx.x: Well that's a man that's played with good bands and has never gotten much recognition. That's funny you know.

Charlie Cordella and another one is, well let me think, he and Charlie worked together quite a while. Years ago there was a band at Pete Hermans before I ever went there. Sharky had the band I believe. Chink Martin played in it and Freddie Newman and Charlie Cordella and Sidney Ayrton played together. And then another boy, Ray, he played very well and he never did get any recognition either.
